data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

May 29, 2024

## [Do not buy from Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/66567e4b86693120680b9aeb)
Do not buy from Lulu and Georgia. Impossible to make contact. No phone 📞 

Very frustrating. I purchased furniture on Friday and tried to cancel order on Sunday because after looking at other beds made from the same material I had just purchased and it was a completely different color. Also, I found the same couch 25% cheaper with no shipping fee. They charged me $500. They are company which takes your money and then says you’re on your own. Very disappointed.

May 28, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Updated Jun 3, 2024

Hi Isa, thank you so much for your feedback regarding our Cancellation policies, we have shared this with our teams. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience that was caused by a delay in a response from our team. Our Customer Experience team cancelled your order as a one time exception, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
